facts.business: Refex Renewables and Infrastructure Limited is an Independent Power Producer (IPP) and full-spectrum EPC provider offering end-to-end solar energy solutions, and has recently entered the compressed biogas (CBG) sector.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty regarding going concern due to losses incurred during the year ended 31st March 2026 leading to full erosion of net worth; however, the opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Ability to create, acquire and build new businesses and grow existing businesses
Ability to attract and retain qualified personnel
Market fluctuations in India and elsewhere around the world
Material uncertainty regarding going concern due to losses and erosion of net worth
facts.related_party_note: Borrowings from related parties include loans from SILRES Energy Solutions Private Limited (secured by first charge on all current assets of a subsidiary, interest 12%-12.5% p.a., repayable on demand) and Refex Holding Private Limited (interest 8%-12% p.a., repayable on demand). Multiple term loans are secured by personal guarantee of Anil Jain and corporate guarantee of Refex Holding Private Limited.
